title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg on 8 ranks, before ISMIP7SCPC.destroy: RSS a rank an evaluation from the timing record
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; no other session's simulation in its 10 s CPU log (foreign_cpu.txt: Time Machine, WindowServer, Defender and the desktop apps, each at most about one core)
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1005.7 MiB after the first evaluation, 1091.8 after the 32nd: 2.05 MiB an evaluation from the 2nd to the 20th and 1.84 from the 21st to the 32nd, with the checkpoint's 25.9 MiB between; peak 1917 MiB
code: 508a9be (the solver cache of 9bc7682 plus the rss_mib field); icepack_tools e7b923e
cost: 295 s wall, 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 7.11 s an evaluation (median after the first)
audit: objective 3.746343e3 after 30 iterations; published residual 9.77e-4 after a 0-iteration final solve; no forward failed
notes: RSS is the timing record's rss_mib, read after each evaluation's adjoint; the step of about 25 MiB at evaluation 21 in every arm is the driver's periodic checkpoint at iteration 20; run with code archived from the commit (git archive), no wrapper
